text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dancing was her little sisters' dream. 
Ines Fujin had believed that all the way 
until the day of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That was why her little sisters scolded 
her. They told her not to decide their 
dreams for them. The pair's wish right now 
was to see their older sister shine."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just her younger sisters. Even 
the coworkers she ran into from her 
part-time job were utterly captivated by 
Ines Fujin's running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running isn't some selfish whim of Ines 
Fujin's. It brings hope to countless 
people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was okay to have fun, and it was okay 
to run as much as she wanted. Realizing 
this, warm tears glistened on Ines Fujin's 
cheeks.
